IPT.evidence_source: IPT-AST. IPT-AST, known to the adolescents as 'Teen Talk,' involves two initial individual sessions and eight weekly 90-minute group sessions. ... IPT-AST is a modification of the group IPT-A manual (Mufson, Gallagher, Dorta, & Young, 2004c).
